_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes: Loading saved configuration now uses supported device commands and both PID sets. Fresh native-timestamped readback, confirmed flash saving and a second complete capture are required before replacing the archived local restore profile. Incomplete or synthesized archived SysID runs cannot replace known-good calibration. Firmware and branch protocol menus are unchanged. Both branch layout/smoke and focused tests passed; Device D live restoration matched its baseline. Controller tracking and independent MAP/SysID transfer qualification remain separate ongoing work.
